tc4_example.research_page.ROD_amethyst.1: A wand rod registered with new WandRod(...): 80 vis, craft cost 4, and an IWandRodOnUpdate hook that slowly regrows Ordo up to a tenth of the capacity. Combine it with any cap you know in the arcane workbench.
tc4_example.research_page.CAP_amethyst.1: A wand cap registered with new WandCap(...): 95% vis cost, 85% for order and entropy.
tc4_example.insight_scroll.unreadable: You cannot make sense of the scroll yet
tc4_example.insight_scroll.read: The scroll crumbles into insight. Warp: %s
An ItemFocusBasic subclass: it costs half a vis of Ignis and a quarter of Aer (centivis 50 and 25), pays with WandHelper.consumeAllVis and accepts the frugal and potency upgrades.
Its recipe is a thaumcraft:arcane_shaped JSON file of the add-on.
tc4_example.research_page.EXAMPLE_BOWL.1: A TileThaumcraft block entity that is an IAspectContainer, an IEssentiaTransport and an IWandable. Pour crystallized essentia in; a tube below draws it out; a wand empties it, and a sneaking wand condenses Ordo from the vis network.
tc4_example.research_page.EXAMPLE_AMULET:
An IBauble amulet with a vis discount, runic charge and one warp. While worn it adds one vis of Ordo to the wand in your hand every five seconds.
Its recipe is a thaumcraft:infusion_stack JSON file of the add-on.
tc4_example.research_page.EXAMPLE_SCROLL:
Reading the scroll adds research points through ThaumcraftApiHelper.addAspectPool and reveals Copper Secrets with completeResearch.
A shapeless arcane recipe object and a thaumcraft:crucible JSON recipe make it.
